extensionDescription.message: Automatically removes Firefox history entries whose URL or page title contains one of your private, locally stored keywords.

quickAddHint.message: New matches in URLs or page titles are removed automatically.

wipeDialogDescription.message: Every existing entry matching your current keywords will be permanently deleted. Other history entries remain untouched.

cleanupResult.message: Deleted $DELETED$ matches after checking $CHECKED$ history entries.

localOnlyDescription.message: No telemetry, accounts, or network requests

automaticCleaningDescription.message: Matching visits are removed as soon as Firefox records their URL or title.

cleanOnStartupDescription.message: Catches visits missed while the add-on was inactive.

keywordListDescription.message: Enter one literal keyword per line. Regular expressions are intentionally not used.

irreversibleDescription.message: Preview first if you are unsure about a rule.

matchFieldRequired.message: Select URLs, page titles, or both.

tooManyKeywords.message: The list is limited to 500 keywords.

previewResult.message: $MATCHED$ matches in $CHECKED$ history entries (showing up to 25).

invalidImport.message: This file is not valid JSON.

importTooLarge.message: The import file is larger than 1 MB.

exceptionsDescription.message: An entry containing an exception is never deleted.

broadRuleDialogDescription.message: Broad keywords can automatically remove many future history entries.

savedWithoutCleanup.message: Rules saved. Existing history was not changed.

noMatchesToDelete.message: No matching history entries were found.

wipePreviewSummary.message: $MATCHED$ of $CHECKED$ history URLs will be deleted, including all visits to those URLs.

wipeRiskHigh.message: High risk: this rule is very broad or matches at least half of your history.

wipeRiskMedium.message: Caution: this rule matches a substantial part of your history.

wipeCancelled.message: Deletion was cancelled. Nothing was removed.

cancellingOperation.message: Cancelling after the current browser request…

keywordTooShort.message: Every keyword must contain at least $MINIMUM$ characters.

operationBusy.message: Another history operation is already running.

previewRequired.message: The history changed or the preview expired. Preview again before deleting.

unknownAction.message: The requested add-on action is unknown.

backgroundRestarted.message: Firefox restarted the background process. Run the operation again.

historyRangeSaturated.message: Firefox returned too many history results for one time range. Nothing was deleted from the incomplete result.

operationFailed.message: Firefox could not complete this history operation.

operationScanningDetail.message: $COUNT$ unique history entries found so far.

operationPreviewDone.message: Preview found $MATCHED$ matches in $CHECKED$ entries. Nothing was deleted.

operationWipeDone.message: $DELETED$ matching entries deleted after checking $CHECKED$ entries.
